**v0.6.0 — AI Design**

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok and Antigravity can run as sessions; edits can be reviewed with Keep or Revert; each turn records duration, tools and changed layers.

What I would actually try:
• Open a real design file locally
• Ask an agent for one bounded change
• Inspect the canvas before accepting it
• Keep or revert the turn
• Check the implementation view
• Compare a captured result with the expected screen

**From “AI generates a screen” to “an agent works inside a design environment with state, review and evidence.”**

The project is free and presented as research/open source. I am sharing the experiment, not claiming a production guarantee.
